text.aria-label: Title text 'How fast the detector notices an ending, on experiment 650's injected shifts in the five development months. Dashed line: the shift ends. Origins are daily, so a point is one day of origins.'

Dashed line: the shift ends. Origins are daily, so a point is one day of origins.
